promises.claim: A bank you don’t bank with yet checks your passport, license or ID card before it opens an account or takes your switch.
The Social Security office asks for your passport in force before it takes an application.
On an F-1, Connecticut’s DMV asks for your Social Security number before it issues an ID card.
If you’re not a citizen, Connecticut’s DMV asks for your passport in force, or OPT’s card, before it issues an ID card.
Each fee leaves your accounts when you apply or replace.
You need to be registered for your program to get the number: once you are, the School’s work-study counts as your on-campus work.
The Social Security office asks for your passport in force.
A 1040-NR filed without a number goes in with an ITIN application, which holds up its refund ${SSN.itinWeeks === 7 ? 'seven' : SSN.itinWeeks} weeks longer.
With a number, the IRS decides a plan within a minute. Without one, it’s by mail in ${PLAN.mailDays} days.
Without a number, a bank that opens accounts for international students opens yours only in a branch.
Unemployment insurance pays a noncitizen only with permission to work in the US, such as OPT in force.
Your status ends on a set day. Once you’re out of status, a marketplace plan ends at the end of the month.
Settling or naturalizing, where an older save’s papers allow it, takes its fee from your accounts at once.
A citizenship by naturalizing joins the one you were born with, and your passport stays your birth country’s.
Residence abroad and permission to work in the US are separate: OPT is the US route for a student.
“${CHAPTER}” in the guide opens Papers and every button on it.
The Health Cover tab holds your cover, your doctor, your conditions and your medical bills.

The Tax Returns tab holds each year’s return, ready each February for a year where you owe tax or are due a refund, or had income of the standard deduction or more, and every year for a student on an F-1.
Notices about your cover, a bill, an appointment, a claim or a document carry Go There, which opens Papers.

Yale Health covers you while you’re at the School; the degree, a withdrawal, a dismissal or a personal leave without Affiliate cover ends it. A withdrawal by the fifteenth day of a term’s classes, or such a leave, ends the cover then or back to its insurance term’s start, and Enroll waits for the first of the next month, unless it’s open enrollment or last month’s income qualifies you for HUSKY D or Covered Connecticut. Otherwise Enroll shows from ${SPECIAL} days before the cover’s end: at once after a dismissal or any other withdrawal.
The Yale Health plan is billed each term with the School’s charges: the living-expense scholarship meets it where need is found, and your bank pays it where none is.
Your cover decides your share each time you have care: a visit, urgent care, an emergency or a stay.
A condition’s month of care and each fill of its medicine are priced at your plan’s copays.
Each marketplace premium paid is kept for the year’s premium tax credit, which the return works out.

A bill unpaid at its due date goes to Owed For Medical Care, a debt your net worth counts; at ${usd(MEDICAL_DEBT.reportAt)} or more, ${MEDICAL_DEBT.reportAfterDays} days on, it marks your credit record.
A stay in hospital excuses you from school of itself; down with the flu, Call In Sick excuses the day.
A booked appointment is a commitment on the calendar, ${CONSULT_MINUTES} minutes at ${clock(CONSULT_HOUR)} on a weekday that isn’t a public holiday, and the clock stops at it.
A visit you keep is billed at once for your share, and its bill joins Care And Its Bills, due in ${MEDICAL_DEBT.dueDays} days.
Your Pharmacy’s cash price is read for every generic fill of a condition’s medicine.
Booking sends “A Doctor’s Appointment” to What Needs You, a missed one “Missed The Doctor”, and a referral “A Referral”.
Each Monday a long-term condition left untreated takes its toll: depression lowers morale, diabetes your condition, arthritis your energy.
Begin A Course Of ${THERAPY.sessions} Sessions puts a session on the calendar each week, a commitment the clock stops at.
A condition kept up books its review as a doctor’s appointment when it falls due.
Keep It Up pays the month’s care at once from ${FROM_CURRENT}; later months and each fill are paid the same way.
The Summer Cabaret’s stipend is the pay a claim counts: its quarters are your base period’s wages.
A Connecticut claim pays only once you’ve left school: graduated, withdrawn or dismissed.
What a claim pays is kept as the year’s unemployment insurance, income on your return.
Each month’s SNAP goes onto the EBT card, and each morning’s groceries are paid from it first.

In the summer recess, a student’s hours of work in the last 30 days, work-study’s among them, are read against SNAP’s ${SNAP.studentHours}; work-study’s pay isn’t counted as income, and at school SNAP’s time limit doesn’t apply.
The Summer Cabaret’s stipend, with FICA withheld, is the work that earns a school life its credits.
A pension paid is kept as the year’s pension income, and Social Security is taxed on the return as IRC 86 says.
Once claimed, each payment goes into the account your payments go to, on its own day.
A year as a nonresident on an F-1 earns no credit: your status is read for each year of your record.
